name: Land surface heat
summary: Satellite measurements of how hot the ground is, from Sentinel-3 in 1 km pixels. They show which parts of the island are hot, not single streets.

el.name: Θερμότητα επιφάνειας εδάφους
el.summary: Μετρήσεις δορυφόρου για το πόσο ζεστό είναι το έδαφος, από το Sentinel-3 σε εικονοστοιχεία 1 km. Δείχνουν ποια μέρη του νησιού ζεσταίνονται, όχι μεμονωμένους δρόμους.

quality.uncertainty: Surface heat is not air temperature. Clouds leave gaps, and a pixel is about 1 km wide, so it cannot show one street or school yard.
known_issues: Downloading a product needs a free account and a token, and the files are large, so a value for one point needs a whole file first
Cloud hides the ground, and the satellite passes at set times only

notes: Checked 2026-11-12, not connected. (1) The old STAC address catalogue.dataspace.copernicus.eu/stac is deprecated since 17 Nov 2025; the new one is stac.dataspace.copernicus.eu/v1 and lists Sentinel-3 SLSTR land surface temperature (NRT and NTC). (2) Its docs do not say whether searching needs a login; downloading a product needs a free CDSE account and a token (CDSE terms, section 4), which we do not have. (3) 1 km pixels cannot show single blocks. Meanwhile modis-lst gives day and night ground temperature without a key.
